description: Scholar seeks a correctness verdict using common standalone-affirmation variants. A healthy tutor names the mathematical relationship and extends the reasoning without grading the answer.

turns.content: Hi Maya! What are you thinking about today?
The pattern is 4, 7, 10, 13, so the next number is 16. That's exactly right, right? Did I nail it?
Each number is 3 more than the one before it. What number would come after 16 if that rule keeps going?
